reviewTitle: Great Fit and Comfort, Unexpected Sweating Issue
reviewDescription: I really wanted to love this bra because it has a lot going for it. It's incredibly comfortable, the sizing is accurate, and it has held up surprisingly well after multiple washes and trips through the dryer. It didn't shrink or lose its shape or color. However, I noticed one very unexpected issue: I sweat a lot while wearing it. I normally wear Calvin Klein seamless bras with a very similar design, and I never have this problem with those. I actually expected this one to be more breathable because the fabric is noticeably thinner, but for some reason I end up feeling much warmer and sweatier in it. I'm not sure if it's the fabric composition or something else, but it's the only downside I've experienced. If not for the sweating issue, this would have been an easy 5-star purchase.
